downstream_risks: Grid clamping to maxGridSize without per-thread strided loop means if N > maxGridSize*blockSize, some elements would be skipped in first pass; in practice maxGridSize is huge (>=2^31-1 on sm_60) so unreachable, but logic is technically incomplete.

Buffer swap in multi-pass loop: d_bufB is sized to maxGridSize, but after swap d_input becomes d_bufB (small) and d_output becomes d_bufA (large) - fine.
